story.title: Last Ebola Patients Depart Treatment Center in DR Congo
story.summary: A treatment center in Ituri province, DR Congo, celebrated the discharge of its last confirmed Ebola patients, marking the first time since May that the facility has had no active cases. Medical staff and local residents participated in a joyful celebration as the clinic, run by Médecins Sans Frontières, reached this significant milestone.

timeline_highlights.title: Congolese Politician Beaten After Promoting Ebola Awareness
timeline_highlights.summary: Marie-Celestin Karondwa, a politician from the ruling UDPS party in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was beaten on Sunday after advocating for Ebola awareness during a radio interview. The incident occurred in Butembo, a region experiencing an Ebola outbreak, as residents reacted violently to his message promoting disease prevention measures.
key_facts: Marie-Celestin Karondwa was a member of the UDPS party.
He was attacked after a radio interview about Ebola awareness.
The incident took place in Butembo, North Kivu province.

timeline_highlights.title: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Surpasses 10,000 Cases Amid Growing Concerns
timeline_highlights.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has exceeded 10,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 4,900 reported deaths. This outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo virus, is noted as the fastest-growing in history, raising alarms about potential spread to other African nations. Currently, there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments available for this strain of the virus.

related_stories.title: DoorDash is acquiring Instacart for $17 billion
related_stories.summary: DoorDash has announced plans to acquire Instacart in a deal valued at approximately $17 billion. This acquisition aims to combine DoorDash's strength in restaurant delivery with Instacart's grocery delivery services, potentially enhancing customer options for food delivery. The deal is expected to close in late 2027 or early 2028.
